evidence: The 2025 hypoxia series and the 2021 incident series describe the same training center and share the period November 2016 to August 2018. The earlier 18487 trainee-exposures supply a different surveillance scope and the person-exposures are not linked. The newer conference abstract and journal abstract describe one 3867-exposure sample.

Both reports describe a serious Swedish chamber event involving an aviator. Höök gives October 1954 and transfer to Stockholm neurology two days later. The Lund account is undated and describes acute recompression in Karlskrona. The later transfer does not establish the earlier treatment site. The available reports cannot establish case identity.
